algorithm: Initialize a degree count for each vertex from 0 to n-1.

Repeat until no more vertices can be processed.
The core number of a vertex is the highest core number for which it remains in the graph after the process.

Check if j and k are connected by an edge to form a triangle with i
Count the number of such valid (j,k) pairs for each i
